text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I often use the incense my grandmother gave me
when I go to sleep, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A gentle, calming scent fills the entire
room... It helps me sleep so soundly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to get plenty of rest.
Now then, let us begin today's training!
